name: Sheet Pan Chicken Pitas with Bell Peppers, Tzatziki, Olives & Feta

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ lemons
3 red bell peppers
3 green bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: Trim and coarsely grate cucumbers, then transfer to a colander and sprinkle with salt. Place the colander in a bowl to catch excess moisture and set aside.
Juice lemons into a large bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the lemon juice along with oil and spices. Stir to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp salt
1 tbsp cumin, ground
1 tbsp paprika
1 tbsp curry powder
¾ tsp cinnamon, ground
¼ tsp cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and slice onions lengthwise into thin pieces; add to the bowl with the marinade.
Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips; add to the bowl.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels and cut crosswise into thin strips; add to the bowl and stir to coat. Divide veggies and chicken between two baking sheet pans and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheets in the oven and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are tender and chicken is cooked through, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince additional garlic; place in a medium bowl. Add yogurt and spices, then stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
1 ½ cups plain Greek yogurt
1 ½ tsp dill, dried
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Use paper towels or a clean cloth to squeeze excess moisture out of the grated cucumber. Add cucumber to the yogurt mixture and stir to combine the tzatziki; set aside.
Cut pitas in half and carefully open the pockets; spread each pocket with tzatziki, then stuff with chicken, veggies, olives, and feta.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 whole grain pitas
1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide pita pockets between plates and enjoy!
